title: Chapter 6486: Gold Village Sealed
content:
Chapter 6486: Gold Village Sealed

Chapter 6486: Gold Village Sealed

“Come catch me! Come catch me!” The longevity spirit circled playfully, creating a spiral of life force.

It channeled all of Paramount’s affinities, creating an engulfing river of life. Those who have entered long ago, such as North Kun God or Tenacious, couldn’t leave the flow.

North Kun God was indeed the disciple of an immortal. Although his grand dao and body changed dramatically in the river, he maintained his dao heart and kept everything together.

Tenacious ranked second on the fardao path, a legendary existence. His speed was not inferior to North Kun God. After stabilizing, he wanted to leave the river and the dream realm.

The latter no longer had any idea of dealing with this, only wanting to return to God Frontier as soon as possible. Unfortunately, the rotation continued.

As for characters such as Seventy-two Origin Ancestor, they couldn’t stabilize their dao heart and body as quickly. Nonetheless, these best primal ancestors still protected their dao heart.

It became obvious that reaching the longevity spirit was virtually impossible. Just escaping was already fortunate.

Suddenly, a melody traveled through the river and coiled around the spirit. It came from the girl resembling a night goddess and her new artifact - Idyllic Flute.

She had incredible potential, able to understand the surface of the flute to play a tune. Immortal strands appeared and rotated around her.

Each note was a manifestation of the grand dao, able to pierce through everything including the river of life.

Listening to the song was akin to being in a courtyard and listening to a grandfather’s tale about legends. The figures in the song were so removed from the present yet became more illuminated with each passing second.

Everything became slower and slower. This stagnation affected all of Paramount and the longevity spirit stopped spinning, looking to be mesmerized and falling asleep.

North Kun God and the others felt the flow stopping while the tune spread to all of the major realms.

It reached Gold Village and Paragon despite the incalculable distance. The lord of Paragon and Alch-deer Emperor along with everyone else became drowsy.

Idyllic Flute came from a great immortal so its power was unstoppable.

However, due to the distance, Alch-deer woke up and shouted: “Watch out! Seal the village, seal your senses!”

The others woke up and poured their golden power outward to seal the village. None could get in or out.

Paragon didn’t have the chance to close, and definitely not Paramount due to the proximity. Both realms became a still image.

“Do it.” A voice came from behind the woman.

“Boom!” Seventy-two Origin Ancestor, Trinity, Skyraiser, Nine-turns Sage, and Eight-armed Immortal Child heard the voice erupting in their mind and waking them up from the stagnation.
